title: After Checkout — Teaser
question:
PROJECT TITLE
After Checkout — Teaser

CREATIVE BRIEF
Develop two independent premium trailer concepts from this idea for a young-adult audience. ChatGPT and Claude will each receive the same brief through Raycast.

Create an original fictional streaming-series concept for viewers 18–28.

A luxury coastal hotel is evacuating guests ahead of a hurricane. A young night concierge notices the same unknown woman on every security monitor at once — lobby, pool, service corridor, rooftop — though no guest matches her description. When the power fails, every elevator door opens onto black ocean water instead of a floor. The concierge realizes the hotel is no longer on the map she knows.

Premium supernatural-thriller tone. Restrained camera, emotional discovery, one impossible beat, hard title payoff. No existing IP, real people, or logos. Pre-AI 2000s-adjacent luxury, not period pastiche — think unsettling present-day prestige horror.

DELIVERY
- Exactly one open-ended, high-paced 12-second Sora sizzler prompt per model
- The writing, imagery, action, sound, music, rhythm, and title impact are one integrated video prompt
- World-building may be slightly futuristic, fantasy, period, or pre-AI 2000s when it serves the concept
- Prioritize an immediate hook, emotional discovery, and a sharp plot-turn payoff
- Include intentional audio, music, ambience, dialogue, and SFX direction inside the prompt
- Do not return a shot list, multiple prompt options, or claim a video was generated
- No visual reference supplied.

RAYCAST WORKFLOW
Run “Start Directors Cut Concept Run.” Enter the project title as argument 1 and leave argument 2 blank to use this copied brief. The command saves the project, rebuilds the Projects index, and copies the canonical prompt for ChatGPT; capture ChatGPT, then repeat with Claude.
